svg.title: Lab K04: Deployments
svg.desc: A Deployment owns a ReplicaSet, which owns the Pods. Delete a Pod and a new one appears.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You say how many. Kubernetes keeps it that way.

svg.text: Delete a Pod and the ReplicaSet notices the gap and makes a new one within seconds.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Deployment is a wish. A controller compares the wish with reality and closes the gap, again and again.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: kubectl delete pod and kubectl get pods -w: the Pod is replaced. kubectl scale deploy api --replicas=6

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
